Sherina — A wonderful soul with compassion and love.

Some people you meet become friends. And some friends, with time, become family. Sherina is that rare blessing — a wonderful soul with compassion and love, who walked into our lives in 2008 and has stayed in our hearts ever since.

Today, as we celebrate her birthday on this legendary day of October 11th — a day she shares with the one and only Amitabh Bachchan — we want to celebrate not just the date, but the beautiful human being she is.

Our story began in the western region of Abu Dhabi, Al Gharbia, Madinat Zayed. Those were golden days. Our weekends were not just weekends — they were celebrations of togetherness. The aroma of homemade food filling the house, endless chit-chats that made time fly, laughter that echoed in the desert air. Even though she still lives there with her beautiful family, those memories still feel warm and alive, like yesterday.

What makes Sherina truly special is the effortless way she bonds. Vini and Sherina get along a lot together — like sisters who found each other late but were always meant to be. Their chemistry, their talks, their understanding — it's a joy to watch.

To Saeed, she is more than a partner — she is a blessing. Saeed is truly blessed to have a partner like Sherina. And together, they are blessed with two adorable boys — Eenu and Peppie. Both are adorable, bright, and full of life — a perfect reflection of the love they are raised with. In the quiet strength of Madinat Zayed, they have built a world full of warmth, and we are so grateful to be a part of it.

And then, there is the Sherina we all admire — the woman who does it all, and still does it with a smile.

One Woman, Many Beautiful Roles — Click each ✨

Excellent English TeacherLoving MotherCaring SisterDoting DaughterWonderful WifeHome MinisterFamily DriverFriend, Philosopher & Guide

And what not! She is a multiple-tasking wonder. She balances life, home, work and relationships so beautifully, and still finds time to share love with all. That is not just management — that is magic.

Sherina, on your birthday, we want to thank you — for your compassion, for your homemade food that tasted like love, for your chit-chats that healed us, for being Vini's dearest companion, and for being the family we chose.

Happy Birthday, Sherina! 🎂

May God bless you and your family abundantly. May this year bring you and Saeed, Eenu and Peppie more success, more laughter, more health and more beautiful reasons to celebrate. You deserve all the joy you give to others, multiplied a thousand times.

And what a legendary day to be born — October 11th — a day of icons!

Dear Sherina,

From the sands of Madinat Zayed to the kitchens where your homemade food became our comfort, you have taught us what family really means.

You are not just Saeed's blessed partner, or Eenu and Peppie's loving mother — you are Vini's sister from another mother, and our family's heart.

On this Oct 11, sharing the day with a legend, we want you to know you are a legend to us — the Home Minister who runs everything with grace, the Teacher who gives words wings, the Driver who never says no, the Friend who always finds time.

May this year be as beautiful as your compassion. May God bless you, Saeed, Eenu and Peppie always.

Keep those chit-chats coming. The weekends in Al Gharbia may have changed, but the warmth remains forever.

With endless love and gratitude,
Antony, Vini & Family
